punchline: People signalled by pagers at random moments reported their most absorbed moments when a task was neither too easy nor too hard.
thirty_sec: Mihaly Csikszentmihalyi noticed painters who forgot hunger while painting. So he handed people pagers that beeped at random moments, and they wrote down what they were doing and how it felt. The most absorbed moments came when challenge and skill matched. Too easy meant boredom, too hard meant anxiety. His book Flow lays it out.
